hooks.command: L=.multivac/cache/graph-refresh.lock; f=$(sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n 1); t=$(git -C "$(dirname "${f:-.}")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$t" ] && [ -e "$t/graphify-out/graph.json" ] && cd "$t"; PATH="$PATH:$PWD/node_modules/.bin"; find "$L" -maxdepth 0 -mmin +30 -exec rmdir {} + 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p .multivac/cache && mkdir "$L" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; { graphify update .; rmdir "$L"; } >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null & exit 0
